hook: A tiny open model matched frontier APIs at Airbnb.

beats.say: Airbnb Engineering fine-tuned Google's small Gemma 4 E2B model for policy classification, served on a single NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000.
Its max F1 score jumped from 0.563 to 0.902, on par with the best frontier APIs. That's open weights plus careful fine-tuning.
Median latency was just 35 milliseconds versus about 900 for the APIs, at roughly one percent of the cost, on one GPU.
